setlist.title: It Must Have Been the Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack-A-Roe** (2 reviews): Best version ever played; Funky slow groove sheds new light on the song's style [7][8]
- **Eyes of the World** (2 reviews): Song takes about three minutes to start as band jams intensely; Jerry and Bob intertwine lines sounding like one impossible guitar [4][12]
- **It Must Have Been the Roses** (1 review): Performance described as perfect [5]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Goes into Supplication instead of High Time [10]
- **Ship of Fools** (1 review): Wonderful treatment with every note perfectly chosen and not rushed [6]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Fifteen-minute performance features perfect guitar tones and crying beauty [5]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-18.sbd.murphy.5596.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.78/5 by 27 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality described as cannot be better; Mix is clear with very deep bass; Faint ghost music between songs suggests another analog generation in lineage [6][13][14]
- **gd1977-05-18.sbd.miller.79012.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 4.72/5 by 47 [2]. Said about its sound: Reel flip fixed with crossfade [2]
- **gd77-05-18.sbd.ladner.4618.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.27/5 by 15 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording is crystal clear with no pops heard; Donna sounds good, which is rare for the reviewer; Sound is gorgeous with lots of extra touches added [7][8][12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer wishes they had whatever the show was taken on [13]
- Reviewer argues performance ranks alongside Cornell and the previous night's show [4]
- Performance is slightly behind the May 7th version but still sweet [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-18.sbd.murphy.5596.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: SBD transferred to DAT, CDRs, EAC, WAV, and SHNv3 by Patrick Murphy [1]
- **gd1977-05-18.sbd.miller.79012.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Confirmed from vault master reel with radio bleed during tuning [2]
- **gd77-05-18.sbd.ladner.4618.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
